issues.problem: Training silently degrades to stock gsplat (full-res, no culling, no depth-colour cache) if the table lookup misses (params object copied/rewrapped by the runtime, or a training viewmat not matching within 1e-5). Nothing asserts that training frames resolve to a view index. Eval isolation itself is sound: test viewmats never match, evaluate() builds fresh params with no table, and cull/half_res are both off after 13000/3000 so even the in-process final measure() cannot be affected.
issues.evidence: renderer.py: k = None if table is None else table.view_index(...); no error path. link.py keys on id(params) with a weakref identity check.
issues.fix: In density.before_backward, raise if step <= 13000 and outputs.get('view_index') is None (every training frame must resolve). Also note duplicate viewmats (rigs) would map to the first match.

issues.problem: culling_off step (simp2+total)//2 = 13000 and the 30000-horizon LR are tied to cfg total_steps=18000, but the runtime's --steps is independent (tools/bench.py default is 30000). A run with another --steps silently gets the 18000 schedule (culling never switches off if steps < 13000; in-process measure on train views would then apply masks).
issues.evidence: core.events: step == (simp_iteration2 + total_steps)//2; runtime.train has no hook to pass steps to the density.
issues.fix: Document/enforce --steps 18000 (bench_request.json already sets 18000); optionally record steps mismatch in the report.

issues.problem: Official keeps half-res views after 3000 until the current shuffled stack empties (up to ~N more iterations); plugin switches exactly at 3001. Also official shuffles without replacement; plugin samples with replacement (runtime), so ~e^-(2000/N) views may be unseen at the depth reinit (fallback to rendered colours, counted in depth_views_fallback). Already listed as a gap; effect expected small.
issues.evidence: official train.py: viewpoint_stack refilled only when empty via getTrainCameras_warn_up(iteration<=3000).
issues.fix: None required; keep reporting depth_views_fallback per run.

issues.problem: Dataset averages (27.33 / 23.14 / 30.08 PSNR) come from the main table and differ slightly from the mean of the appendix per-scene values (27.35 / 23.13 / 30.04). Per-scene values match the v1 Table 7 exactly (364/364 entries, incl. 3DGS, 3DGS-accel, MSv2-D, Mini-Splatting(-D) rows; johnson mapped to drjohnson).
issues.evidence: scripted comparison of paper_results.json against source/paper.txt Table 7: 0 mismatches.
issues.fix: For subset benchmarks (bicycle/garden/counter, drjohnson/playroom) compare to per-scene values, never to these dataset averages; mention the paper-internal rounding inconsistency.

issues.problem: Probe checks output shape and mean target colour but not that K is scaled consistently (FoV unchanged) or that eval views are not culled; a wrong K scale would pass. (Code review: scale_intrinsics scales fx,cx by w2/w and fy,cy by h2/h, equal to the official FoV-preserving camera; correct.)
issues.evidence: probes.py half_res asserts shapes and loss_target mean only.
issues.fix: Add an assertion that the half-res render of a point equals the full-res pixel position / 2 (projection check).

summary: Code-vs-official audit found no critical or major deviation. Verified against source/code @5ec9202: clone cadence (500..2750 step 250, skipping 2000, nested inside iteration<3000, 9 passes) and MCMC N=2 formula; event order at 1000/2000/3000; depth reinit at 2000 with num_depth taken before the preserving prune; simplification at 3000/8000 and the 0.99 CDF cut (including the official +1e-6 offset quirk); culling (masks recomputed with no culling during the pass, rows kept aligned through duplicate/split/remove, cleared at (8000+18000)//2=13000); sparse Adam identical to the official Taming-style wrapper (the gsplat fused kernel has no bias correction, so the folded lr is correct); half-res cameras scale K as the FoV-preserving official cameras and densify gradients use the rendered (half) width; SH degree 0 until 4000 via shN zeroing plus moment zeroing; opacity LR 0.025; position LR with 30000-step horizon overriding the runtime's 18000-horizon decay (set after opt.step, so the plugin value wins). The link side-channel cannot misapply masks to eval views (viewmat match only on training views, fresh params at evaluate(), culling/half-res already off at the end) but fails open silently in training; add a guard. paper_results.json per-scene values match the v1 Table 7 for all 364 entries. Remaining risk is empirical (no full run yet), not structural.
